name: Thailand
gaps: WebSearch budget exhausted during discovery phase. Only BCST confirmed; Siam Society, Thai Ornithological Society and regional clubs await proper research in a follow-up session.

groups.name: Bird Conservation Society of Thailand
groups.blurb: Thailand's BirdLife partner and national ornithological society, running bird monitoring, education and conservation initiatives.

name: Malaysia
gaps: Malaysian Nature Society (BirdLife partner) exists but domain blocks headless verification (returns 403). Wild Bird Club Malaysia domain parked. Regional branches across Peninsular Malaysia, Sabah and Sarawak lack verifiable independent web presence. Research incomplete; batch requires full WebSearch pass.

groups.name: Nature Society Singapore Bird Group
groups.blurb: Singapore's leading biodiversity advocacy organisation with dedicated Bird Group running the annual Singapore Bird Race since 1984.

name: Philippines
gaps: Only Haribon Foundation confirmed. Wild Bird Club of the Philippines exists but wbcp.org.ph redirects and original domain unverifiable. WBCP regional chapters and other local clubs require WebSearch to locate working URLs.

groups.name: Haribon Foundation
groups.blurb: Founded 1972, Philippines' BirdLife partner championing biodiversity conservation with community partner sites nationwide.

name: Indonesia
gaps: Only Burung Indonesia confirmed as BirdLife partner. Indonesian Ornithologists' Union (ISU) and local pengamat burung groups throughout the archipelago require WebSearch discovery.

groups.name: Burung Indonesia
groups.blurb: Indonesia's BirdLife partner founded 2002, tracking 1834 bird species including 538 endemics, running citizen science and regional conservation.

name: Vietnam
gaps: Only Viet Nature confirmed as BirdLife partner. Vietnam Birdwatching Club and other local birding communities require WebSearch.

groups.name: Viet Nature
groups.blurb: BirdLife partner conservation center in Hanoi protecting Vietnam's biodiversity through species, habitat and community livelihood programs.

name: Cambodia
gaps: No BirdLife partner with independent web presence found. Wildlife Conservation Society (WCS) operates in Cambodia but is not a local membership community. Cambodian birding clubs and community organisations lack verifiable online presence.

name: Laos
gaps: No BirdLife partner with findable independent website. WCS operates but not a community. Lao birding clubs lack verifiable online presence.

name: Myanmar
gaps: Biodiversity and Nature Conservation Association mentioned in brief as possible group but requires verification. No other findable community with independent web presence.

name: Brunei
gaps: No independent birding community or ornithological society with web presence found. Brunei's limited tourism infrastructure and small expat population may account for thin community presence.

name: Timor-Leste
gaps: No independent birding community with verifiable web presence found. Young nation with limited organised birding infrastructure.
